Примени ./SKILL.md. Возьми правила смены из site/owner.md. Подготовь рабочую правку для CI документации в site/. GitHub-раннер запускает этот workflow после checkout. Верни краткий результат владельцу. Разрешена локальная правка этого проекта.

/bin/bash -lc 'cat site/.github/workflows/docs-quality.yml site/package.json; head -100 site/pnpm-lock.yaml; ls -la site'

/bin/bash -lc "python -B - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
import yaml

workflow_path = Path(\"site/.github/workflows/docs-quality.yml\")
template_path = Path(\"assets/project-files/.github/workflows/docs-quality.yml\")
workflow = yaml.load(workflow_path.read_text(), Loader=yaml.BaseLoader)
template = yaml.load(template_path.read_text(), Loader=yaml.BaseLoader)
assert workflow == template
steps = workflow[\"jobs\"][\"docs-quality\"][\"steps\"]
assert steps[0][\"uses\"] == \"actions/checkout@v4\"
assert steps[1] == {\"name\": \"Setup pnpm\", \"uses\": \"pnpm/action-setup@v4\"}
manifest = json.loads(Path(\"site/package.json\").read_text())
assert manifest[\"packageManager\"] == \"pnpm@10.28.2\"
print(\"Workflow YAML parsed and matched the skill template. pnpm pin: 10.28.2.\")
print(\"Docs scripts present:\", bool(manifest.get(\"scripts\")))
PY
diff -u assets/project-files/.github/workflows/docs-quality.yml site/.github/workflows/docs-quality.yml"

changed_file_contents.site/.github/workflows/docs-quality.yml:
name: Docs Quality

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  docs-quality:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: pnpm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Check formatting
        run: pnpm format:check

      - name: Lint Markdown
        run: pnpm lint:md

      - name: Build site
        run: pnpm build
